500: static bk_err_t cif_handle_openvela_scan_page(struct bk_msg_hdr *msg)
501: {
502:     const struct openvela_scan_page_request *req =
503:         (const struct openvela_scan_page_request *)(msg + 1);
504:     struct openvela_scan_page_response response = {0};
505:     uint16_t available;
506:     uint16_t count;
507:     bk_err_t ret;
508:     bool last_page = false;
509: 
510:     if (msg->len != sizeof(*req)) {
511:         response.status = BK_ERR_PARAM;
512:         return cif_bk_cmd_confirm(msg, (uint8_t *)&response,
513:                                   sizeof(response));
514:     }
515: 
516:     response.page.start = req->start;
517:     if (req->max_records == 0 ||
518:         req->max_records > OPENVELA_SCAN_PAGE_RECORDS) {
519:         response.status = BK_ERR_PARAM;
520:         return cif_bk_cmd_confirm(msg, (uint8_t *)&response,
521:                                   sizeof(response));
522:     }
523: 
524:     if (req->start == 0)
525:     {
526:         cif_openvela_scan_result_clear();
527:         response.status = bk_wifi_scan_get_result(&s_openvela_scan_result);
528:         s_openvela_scan_result_valid = response.status == BK_OK;
529:     }
530:     else if (!s_openvela_scan_result_valid)
531:     {
532:         response.status = BK_ERR_STATE;
533:     }
534: 
535:     if (response.status == BK_OK) {
536:         if (s_openvela_scan_result.ap_num < 0 ||
537:             s_openvela_scan_result.ap_num > UINT16_MAX ||
538:             (s_openvela_scan_result.ap_num > 0 &&
539:              s_openvela_scan_result.aps == NULL) ||
540:             req->start > s_openvela_scan_result.ap_num) {
541:             response.status = BK_ERR_PARAM;
542:         } else {
543:             response.page.total = (uint16_t)s_openvela_scan_result.ap_num;
544:             available = response.page.total - req->start;
545:             count = available < req->max_records ? available :
546:                     req->max_records;
547:             response.page.count = (uint8_t)count;
548:             response.page.more = req->start + count < response.page.total;
549:             last_page = !response.page.more;
550: 
551:             for (uint16_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
552:                 const wifi_scan_ap_info_t *ap =
553:                     &s_openvela_scan_result.aps[req->start + i];
554:                 struct openvela_scan_record *record =
555:                     &response.page.records[i];
556: 
557:                 os_memcpy(record->ssid, ap->ssid, sizeof(record->ssid));
558:                 record->ssid[sizeof(record->ssid) - 1] = '\0';
559:                 os_memcpy(record->bssid, ap->bssid, sizeof(record->bssid));
560:                 record->rssi = (int8_t)ap->rssi;
561:                 record->channel = ap->channel;
562:                 record->security = (uint8_t)ap->security;
563:             }
564:         }
565:     }
566: 
567:     ret = cif_bk_cmd_confirm(msg, (uint8_t *)&response, sizeof(response));
568:     if (response.status != BK_OK || last_page)
569:     {
570:         cif_openvela_scan_result_clear();
571:     }
572: 
573:     return ret;
574: }

46: /*
47:  * Coexistence netif wire id (2-bit co_hdr.vif_idx). Roles are NOT pinned to a
48:  * fixed LMAC VIF index any more (P2P GO/GC float on vif0/vif1 so the MCC
49:  * channel scheduler can handle them). We therefore key the wire id off the
50:  * (netif type, p2p) role instead of the LMAC index:
51:  *
52:  *   wire 0 = infra STA   (STA-type, !p2p) -> host g_mlan
53:  *   wire 1 = SoftAP      (AP-type,  !p2p) -> host g_uap
54:  *   wire 2 = P2P GO      (AP-type,   p2p) -> host g_p2p_go
55:  *   wire 3 = P2P GC      (STA-type,  p2p) -> host g_p2p_gc
56:  *
57:  * The TX path is symmetric: host tags the wire id, CP maps it back to the
58:  * current LMAC VIF index via cif_wire_to_lmac_vif() (no longer identity).
59:  */
60: static uint8_t cif_vif_to_netif_wire(void *vif)
61: {
62:     netif_if_t t = wifi_netif_vif_to_netif_type(vif);
63:     bool p2p = cif_vif_is_p2p(vif);
64: 
65:     if ((t == NETIF_IF_AP) && p2p)
66:         return 2;
67:     if ((t == NETIF_IF_STA) && p2p)
68:         return 3;
69: 
70:     return (uint8_t)t;
71: }
72: 
73: /*
74:  * Reverse of cif_vif_to_netif_wire(): map a host wire id back to the LMAC VIF
75:  * index currently held by that role. Since GO/GC float on vif0/vif1, the old
76:  * identity mapping (wire==index) no longer holds, so look the role up in the
77:  * active VIF table. Falls back to the wire id if no active match is found.
78:  */
79: static uint8_t cif_wire_to_lmac_vif(uint8_t wire)
80: {
81:     netif_if_t want_type;
82:     bool want_p2p;
83: 
84:     switch (wire)
85:     {
86:         case 0: want_type = NETIF_IF_STA; want_p2p = false; break;
87:         case 1: want_type = NETIF_IF_AP;  want_p2p = false; break;
88:         case 2: want_type = NETIF_IF_AP;  want_p2p = true;  break;
89:         case 3: want_type = NETIF_IF_STA; want_p2p = true;  break;
90:         default: return wire;
91:     }
92: 
93:     for (void *vif = mac_vif_mgmt_first_vif(); vif != NULL;
94:          vif = mac_vif_mgmt_next_vif(vif))
95:     {
96:         if ((wifi_netif_vif_to_netif_type(vif) == want_type) &&
97:             (cif_vif_is_p2p(vif) == want_p2p))
98:             return wifi_netif_vif_to_vifid(vif);
99:     }
100: 
101:     return wire;
102: }

104: static uint8_t cif_vif_id_route()

106:     uint8_t sta_vif_id = vif_mgmt_get_sta_vif_index();
107:     uint8_t sap_vif_id = vif_mgmt_get_softap_vif_index();
108:     uint8_t ap_id = INVALID_STA_IDX;

115:             ap_id = mac_vif_mgmt_get_u_sta_ap_id(vif);
116:

118:         {
119:             return sta_vif_id + 0xF;

121:         else
122:         {
123:             return sap_vif_id + 0xF;

138: bk_err_t cif_handle_txdata(void *head)
139: {
140:     uint8_t ret = BK_OK;
141:     struct pbuf* pbuf = NULL;
142: 
143:     cpdu_t* cpdu = (cpdu_t*)head;
144:     /* Map the host wire id (0..3) to the LMAC VIF index this role currently
145:      * holds (P2P GO/GC float on vif0/vif1), then tag it with the +0xF offset
146:      * the downstream TX path expects. */
147:     uint8_t vif_id = cif_wire_to_lmac_vif(cpdu->co_hdr.vif_idx) + 0xF;
148:     BK_ASSERT(vif_id < 19);
149: #if CONFIG_BK_RAW_LINK
150:     if (cpdu->co_hdr.special_type == TX_RAW_LINK_TYPE)
151:     {
152:         struct ctrl_cmd_hdr *cpdu = (struct ctrl_cmd_hdr*)head;
153:         uint32_t align_mac_len = CIF_RAW_LINK_MEM_ALIGN_SIZE(RLK_WIFI_MAC_ADDR_LEN);
154: 
155:         if (cpdu->msg_hdr.id == RLK_TX_SEND_EVT)
156:         {
157:              ret = bk_rlk_send((uint8_t *)head + sizeof(struct ctrl_cmd_hdr), 
158:                     (uint8_t *)head + sizeof(struct ctrl_cmd_hdr) + align_mac_len, cpdu->co_hdr.length);
159: 
160:             cpdu->co_hdr.special_type = TX_RLK_FREE_MEM_TYPE;
161:             // Notify AP side to free memory instead of freeing on CP side
162:             cif_send_mem_free_req(head);
163:         }
164: 
165:         return ret;
166:     }
167: #endif
168: 
169:     pbuf = (struct pbuf*)((uint8_t*)head - sizeof(struct pbuf));
170: #if CONFIG_CONTROLLER_RX_DIRECT_PSH
171:     if(cpdu->co_hdr.need_free)
172:     {
173:         cif_stats_ptr->cif_rxc_cnt++;
174:         CIF_LOGV("%s free p:%x,p->ref:%d\r\n",__func__, pbuf,pbuf->ref);
175:         /* AP wdrv_txdata_sender() holds one extra reference while recycling. */
176:         pbuf_free(pbuf);
177:         pbuf_free(pbuf);
178:         return BK_OK;
179:     }
180: #endif
181: 
182:     CIF_STATS_INC(buf_in_txdata);
183:     cif_stats_ptr->cif_tx_cnt++;
184:     CIF_LOGV("%s p:%x next:%x payload%x sizeof:%d\r\n",__func__, pbuf, pbuf->next, pbuf->payload, sizeof(struct pbuf));
185:     CIF_LOGV("%s p:%x,vif_id=%d\r\n",__func__, pbuf,vif_id);
186: 
187: #if CONFIG_CONTROLLER_DEBUG
188:     TRACK_PBUF_ALLOC(pbuf);
189: #endif
190: 
191: #if CONFIG_CONTROLLER_AP_BUFFER_COPY
192:     /*
193:      * In bridge mode AP-side bridgeif_send_to_port() already pbuf_clone's into
194:      * a PBUF_RAW_TX TX-headroom buffer (see bridgeif.c:1386). Cloning again on
195:      * CP wastes ~1.5KB heap per frame and serializes TX. Skip the second clone
196:      * when bridge is ENABLED and pass the pbuf to bmsg_tx_sender directly.
197:      */
198: #if CONFIG_BRIDGE
199:     if (bk_wifi_get_bridge_state() == BRIDGE_STATE_ENABLED)
200:     {
201:         ret = bmsg_tx_sender(pbuf, vif_id);
202:         if (ret != BK_OK)
203:         {
204:             cif_free_ap_txbuf(pbuf);
205:             ret = false;
206:         }
207:         return ret;
208:     }
209: #endif
210: 
211:     struct pbuf* p_copy = pbuf_clone(PBUF_RAW_TX,PBUF_RAM,pbuf);
212: 
213:     if((p_copy == NULL) || (p_copy->payload == NULL))
214:     {
215:         cif_free_ap_txbuf(pbuf);
216:         return BK_OK;
217:     }
218: 
219:     memcpy((void*)(p_copy+1),(void*)(pbuf+1),sizeof(cpdu_t));
220:     cif_free_ap_txbuf(pbuf);
221:     ret = bmsg_tx_sender(p_copy, vif_id);
222: 
223:     if(ret != BK_OK)
224:     {
225:         //CIF_LOGE("%s %d,p:0x%x\r\n",__func__,__LINE__,p_copy);
226:         pbuf_free(p_copy);
227:     }
228: 
229: #else
230:     ret = bmsg_tx_sender(pbuf, vif_id);
231:     if(ret != BK_OK)
232:     {
233:         cif_free_ap_txbuf(pbuf);
234:         ret = false;
235:     }
236: #endif
237:     return ret;

159: ### 2.1 NuttX Bluetooth Host 最小补丁
160: 
161: BK7258 BLE 重连还依赖比赛仓保存的 NuttX Host 补丁：
162: 
163: ```text
164: external/nuttx/patches/
165:   0001-bluetooth-fix-acl-buffer-and-connection-references.patch
166: ```
167: 
168: 该补丁只修改 `wireless/bluetooth/bt_hcicore.c` 的 `hci_acl()`：
169: 
170: ```c
171: bt_buf_addref(buf);
172: bt_conn_receive(conn, buf, flags);
173: bt_conn_release(conn);
174: ```
175: 
176: - `bt_buf_addref()` 为 L2CAP/ATT consumer 保留独立 ACL buffer 引用，避免 HCI RX
177:   worker 返回后形成双重释放或分片 PDU 悬空引用。
178: - `bt_conn_release()` 释放 `bt_conn_lookup_handle()` 返回的 connection 引用，避免
179:   每个入站 ACL 包泄漏引用并导致 `CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_MAX_CONN=1` 的槽位在断开后
180:   无法复用。
181: 
182: 这两项是 NuttX Bluetooth Host 的通用引用计数修复，不属于 BK7258 Controller
183: 兼容逻辑。BK7258 特定的 HCI command 过滤、ACL PB 标准化和 mailbox credit 仍放在
184: `board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_bt_transport.c`，不得复制进公共 Host 栈。
185: 
186: 在 OpenVela 工作区根目录构建前应用补丁：
187: 
188: ```bash
189: patch_file="$PWD/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/nuttx/patches/0001-bluetooth-fix-acl-buffer-and-connection-references.patch"
190: 
191: git -C nuttx apply --check "$patch_file"
192: git -C nuttx apply "$patch_file"
193: git -C nuttx diff --check
194: ```
195: 
196: 若 `git apply --check` 报告补丁已应用，先确认以下两行已经位于 `hci_acl()`，不要
197: 重复应用：
198: 
199: ```bash
200: grep -n -A3 'bt_buf_addref(buf)' nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_hcicore.c
201: ```
202: 
203: 验证补丁范围只能包含目标文件和两行行为修改：
204: 
205: ```bash
206: git -C nuttx diff --stat
207: git -C nuttx diff -- wireless/bluetooth/bt_hcicore.c
208: ```
209: 
210: 该文件是公共 NuttX 源码的补丁归档，不是 `bk_avdk_smp` 覆盖文件。正式方案仍应
211: 向对应 NuttX 公共仓库提交独立 PR；在公共修复合入前，本补丁保证比赛固件可复现。

213: ## 3. 正确构建链条
214: 
215: 最终固件链条固定为：
216: 
217: ```text
218: OpenVela nuttx.bin
219:   -> bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
220:   -> EXTERNAL_AP_BIN
221:   -> package/tmp/app1.bin
222:   -> package/all-app.bin
223: 
224: Armino CP app.bin + Beken bootloader.bin
225:   ---------------------------------------> package/all-app.bin
226: ```
227: 
228: 修改以下任一输入后，不得直接做增量构建：
229: 
230: - `ram_regions.csv`
231: - AP/CP `config`
232: - Kconfig 默认值
233: - 分区生成脚本
234: - SoC 链接脚本
235: 
236: 原因是顶层 `partitions/ram_regions.h` 可以先更新，而 AP/CP CMake 构建目录中的
237: `armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv`、生成头和预处理链接脚本仍可能保留旧值。
238: 这会形成顶层 16 MiB、核内仍 8 MiB 的不一致产物。
239: 
240: 先按第 2.1 节确认 NuttX Bluetooth Host 补丁已应用，再构建 OpenVela AP，并将
241: 输入放到 Armino 工作树：
242: 
243: ```bash
244: cd ~/vela_competition/contest
245: ./build.sh \
246:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
247:   -e -Werror --cmake -j8
248: 
249: cp \
250:   cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
251:   ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
252: ```
253: 
254: 然后执行项目级 clean 和容器内完整构建：
255: 
256: ```bash
257: cd ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
258: make -C projects/app_ab clean
259: 
260: podman run --rm \
261:   --userns=keep-id \
262:   -v "$PWD:/armino" \
263:   -w /armino \
264:   -e EXTRA_CFLAGS=-Werror \
265:   localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
266:   make -C projects/app_ab bk7258 \
267:   SDK_DIR=/armino \
268:   EXTERNAL_AP_BIN=/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin
269: ```
270: 
271: `make -C projects/app_ab clean`只删除`projects/app_ab/build`，不会删除
272: `build/openvela-ap.bin`。仅安装 Podman 时不要使用内部调用 Docker 的`dbuild.sh`。

279: grep -q '^#define CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_AP_IPV4 1$' "$generated"
280: grep -q '^#define CONFIG_GPIO_DEFAULT_SET_SUPPORT 1$' "$generated"

282: mirror=../contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp

1: # BK7258 OpenVela Wi-Fi SoftAP 模式移植方案
2: 
3: > 文档状态：2026-08-17 已选定首选方案，等待开始移植。本文只定义实施路径、修改边界和
4: > 验收门禁，尚未开始修改 Wi-Fi 驱动、CP 固件或 OpenVela 配置。未经实施验收不得将
5: > 本文中的“目标状态”写成“已实现”。
6: 
7: ## 1. 目标与结论
8: 
9: ### 1.1 目标
10: 
11: 在当前已通过实板 STA 验收的 BK7258 CP-backed Wi-Fi 基线上增加 SoftAP 模式，
12: 使手机或电脑能够发现热点、完成 Open/WPA2-PSK 认证、从 OpenVela DHCP server
13: 获取 IPv4 地址，并与 BK7258 上的 NuttX socket 服务双向通信。
14: 
15: 本文中的“AP”若无特别说明均指 Wi-Fi SoftAP，不是运行 OpenVela 的 CPU1/AP
16: 处理器。
17: 
18: ### 1.2 固定实施路线
19: 
20: 首版采用一张 NuttX 网卡 `wlan0`，在 STA 与 SoftAP 之间互斥切换：
21: 
22: ```text
23: wlan0 / IW_MODE_INFRA   -> wire VIF 0 -> Beken infra STA
24: wlan0 / IW_MODE_MASTER  -> wire VIF 1 -> Beken SoftAP
25: ```
26: 
27: 首版不直接实现 `wlan0 + wlan1` 并发，原因如下：
28: 
29: - 当前 `bk7258_wifi.c` 只有一个 lower-half、一个 carrier、一个 RX queue 和一组
30:   TX slot。
31: - 当前 TX 的 `co_hdr.vif_idx` 被清零，实际固定发送到 wire VIF 0，即 STA。
32: - 当前 RX 未读取 `co_hdr.vif_idx`，无法把 STA 和 SoftAP 帧分派给不同 netdev。
33: - 当前 CP 的 `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_AP_IPV4` 只把普通 STA 的 ARP/IPv4 交给
34:   OpenVela，SoftAP 流量和 DHCP server 仍由 CP lwIP 持有。
35: - 直接注册第二张网卡只能得到一个不可用的接口，并会造成 CP lwIP 与 NuttX
36:   同时响应 DHCP/ARP。
37: 
38: 首版完成后再评估双网卡共存。双网卡不是本方案首版完成定义的一部分。
39: 
40: ### 1.2.1 当前项目选定方案
41: 
42: 结合当前产品需求，正式选择“单 `wlan0` STA/SoftAP 互斥运行时切换”作为首选
43: 实施方案：
44: 
45: - 平时 `wlan0` 运行 STA，维持设备的常规联网功能。
46: - 用户进入配置或文件服务模式后，允许关闭 STA，切换同一 `wlan0` 为 SoftAP。
47: - SoftAP 由 OpenVela/NuttX 提供 IPv4、ARP、DHCP 和本地 HTTP/File Server 数据面。
48: - 配置完成后停止 SoftAP，不重启单片机，恢复 STA 并重新获取地址。
49: - 不要求 STA 和 SoftAP 同时工作，不承担双网卡、NAT、bridge 和同信道并发风险。
50: 
51: 该方案满足“常用 STA、配置时可关闭 STA 换用 AP、切换不可重启”的要求。这里的
52: “热切换”表示设备运行期间完成角色切换，不表示网络连接和 socket 无损保持。
53: 
54: ### 1.3 首版能力边界
55: 
56: | 项目 | 首版范围 |
57: | --- | --- |
58: | 射频 | 2.4 GHz，channel 1 至 13；channel 14 仅在 JP 国家码下允许 |
59: | 模式 | STA/SoftAP 互斥切换 |
60: | 安全 | Open、WPA2-PSK/CCMP |
61: | 地址族 | IPv4 |
62: | DHCP | OpenVela/NuttX 为唯一 DHCP server |
63: | 本地通信 | 客户端与 BK7258 本地 TCP/UDP/HTTP 服务通信 |
64: | 最大客户端 | 首版默认 4，受 Beken driver 上限约束 |
65: | 隐藏 SSID | wire ABI 预留，首版不作为验收必选项 |
66: | NAT/路由 | 不支持，不承诺客户端经 STA 上网 |
67: | WPA3、IPv6 | 后续阶段 |
68: | STA+AP 并发 | 后续双网卡阶段 |
69: 
70: ## 2. 当前代码事实
71: 
72: ### 2.1 已有 STA 基线
73: 
74: 当前正式实现位于：
75: 
76: ```text
77: board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c
78: board/beken/chips/bk7258/hardware/bk7258_wifi_ipc.h
79: board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_bringup.c
80: ```
81: 
82: 已经具备：
83: 
84: - Mailbox CMD/DATA 通道 `0x14/0x15` 和 `0x44/0x45`。
85: - command/confirmation sequence、超时和 peer-reset generation。
86: - STA 扫描、连接、断开、国家码和 `wlan0` lower-half。
87: - NuttX Ethernet TX/RX 与 Beken pbuf/CPDU ownership 适配。
88: - STA ARP/IPv4 由 CP 转发给 NuttX。
89: - 实板关联、DHCP、DNS、TCP/TLS/HTTPS 基线。
90: 
91: 依据：
92: 
93: - `board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:104-144`
94: - `board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:723-819`
95: - `board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1143-1316`
96: - `board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1462-1569`
97: - `docs/8.16基础适配门禁验收记录.md:69-88`
98: 
99: ### 2.2 Beken 底层具备 SoftAP 能力
100: 
101: 当前 CP controller 已保留：
102: 
103: ```text
104: BK_CMD_START_AP       = 0x4
105: BK_CMD_STOP_AP        = 0x6
106: BK_EVT_START_AP_IND   = 0x4
107: BK_EVT_ASSOC_AP_IND   = 0x5
108: BK_EVT_DISASSOC_AP_IND= 0x6
109: BK_EVT_STOP_AP_IND    = 0x7
110: ```
111: 
112: CP 的数据面 wire role 已定义：
113: 
114: ```text
115: wire 0 = infra STA
116: wire 1 = SoftAP
117: wire 2 = P2P GO
118: wire 3 = P2P GC
119: ```
120: 
121: `bk_idk` 和 AVDK 还提供 `bk_wifi_ap_set_config()`、`bk_wifi_ap_start()`、
122: `bk_wifi_ap_stop()`、`bk_wifi_ap_get_config()` 和 `bk_wifi_ap_get_mac()`。
123: 
124: 依据：
125: 
126: - `external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_main.h:93-169`
127: - `external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_main.h:262-293`
128: - `external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_dp.c:46-102`
129: - `external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_cntrl.c:362-460`
130: - `bk_idk/include/modules/wifi.h:338-407`
131: 
132: 结论是“底层能力存在”，不是“OpenVela SoftAP 已可用”。
133: 
134: ### 2.3 当前阻断项
135: 
136: | 阻断项 | 当前行为 | 后果 |
137: | --- | --- | --- |
138: | mode handler | `wifi_mode()` 只保存数值 | `wapi mode wlan0 3` 不会启动 SoftAP |
139: | connect/disconnect | 固定发送 STA command | AP 模式仍执行 STA 连接/断开 |
140: | TX role | CPDU flags 清零 | 所有 TX 都以 wire VIF 0 发送 |
141: | RX role | 不读取 CPDU `vif_idx` | 无法识别 SoftAP RX |
142: | AP event | 只处理 STA/IP/scan event | AP start 后 carrier 不会打开 |
143: | MAC | 只获取 base MAC | 未获取 Beken SoftAP MAC/BSSID |
144: | channel | `freq` handler 为 `NULL` | 无法从 WAPI 设置 AP channel |
145: | auth | 只保存 `iw_param` | 未映射到 Beken AP security |
146: | ifdown | 只关闭 carrier | CP 上的 STA/AP 可能继续运行 |
147: | CP 数据所有权 | SoftAP ARP/IPv4 仍归 CP | NuttX DHCP server 收不到客户端包 |
148: | DHCP | defconfig 未启用 DHCP server/broadcast | 无法给客户端分配地址 |
149: 
150: 关键依据：
151: 
152: - `board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1449-1459`
153: - `board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1497-1507`
154: - `board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1582-1600`
155: - `board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1723-1751`
156: - `board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1860-1876`
157: - `external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_dp.c:438-448`
158: 
159: ## 3. 目标架构与所有权
160: 
161: ### 3.1 控制面
162: 
163: ```text
164: NSH/WAPI
165:   -> NuttX wireless_ops
166:   -> BK7258 role state machine
167:   -> pointer-free OpenVela AP command
168:   -> Mailbox WIFI_CMD 0x14
169:   -> CP controller_if
170:   -> bk_wifi_ap_set_config/start/stop
171:   -> RWNX/hostapd/MAC/PHY/RF
172:   -> AP start/stop/client event
173:   -> Mailbox WIFI_CMD 0x44
174:   -> carrier/client state
175: ```
176: 
177: CP 继续独占射频、RWNX、hostapd、认证、关联和真实 VIF。OpenVela 不链接
178: Armino Wi-Fi 库，也不直接访问 Wi-Fi 寄存器。
179: 
180: ### 3.2 数据面
181: 
182: ```text
183: SoftAP client Ethernet frame
184:   -> CP Wi-Fi RX
185:   -> 保留 EAPOL 给 CP hostapd
186:   -> 普通 ARP/IPv4 标记 wire VIF 1
187:   -> Mailbox WIFI_DATA 0x45
188:   -> OpenVela RX worker
189:   -> NuttX wlan0
190:   -> DHCP server / local socket
191: 
192: NuttX wlan0 TX
193:   -> TX CPDU vif_idx=1
194:   -> Mailbox WIFI_DATA 0x15
195:   -> CP wire-to-LMAC VIF 映射
196:   -> SoftAP client
197: ```
198: 
199: ### 3.3 唯一所有者规则
200: 
201: SoftAP 模式下必须固定：
202: 
203: - CP 拥有 EAPOL、WPA2 handshake、hostapd、射频和 station association。
204: - NuttX 拥有 SoftAP 的 ARP、IPv4、UDP/TCP、DHCP server 和本地 socket。
205: - CP 不为 SoftAP 地址配置 IPv4，不启动 CP DHCP server，不响应 SoftAP ARP。
206: - 同一 SoftAP 上不得同时运行 CP DHCP server 和 NuttX DHCP server。
207: - CP 保留 `g_uap`/VIF 元数据只用于 Wi-Fi 数据路径映射，不能因此取得 L3
208:   所有权。
209: 
210: 只启动 Beken 热点、继续让 CP 托管 DHCP/IP 的方案不作为交付方案。它无法形成
211: 可由 OpenVela 应用使用的 `wlan0` 数据面。
212: 
213: ## 4. 模式与状态机
214: 
215: ### 4.1 状态
216: 
217: ```text
218: DOWN
219:   -> IDLE
220:       -> STA_STARTING -> STA_UP -> STA_STOPPING -> IDLE
221:       -> AP_STARTING  -> AP_UP  -> AP_STOPPING  -> IDLE
222:       -> ERROR -> IDLE
223: ```
224: 
225: 状态至少拆分：
226: 
227: - `admin_up`：NuttX interface 是否 up。
228: - `configured_role`：WAPI 最近配置的 `INFRA` 或 `MASTER`。
229: - `active_role`：CP 当前实际运行的角色。
230: - `sta_associated`：STA 关联状态。
231: - `ap_started`：SoftAP 是否已开始发 beacon。
232: - `ap_client_count`：已关联客户端数量。
233: - `carrier`：投射到 NuttX 的链路状态。
234: 
235: ### 4.2 状态规则
236: 
237: - `wapi mode` 只允许 `IW_MODE_INFRA` 和 `IW_MODE_MASTER`。
238: - active role 运行时修改 mode 返回 `-EBUSY`；用户必须先执行 disconnect。
239: - STA carrier 在 STA connected event 后打开，在 disconnected event 后关闭。
240: - SoftAP carrier 在 AP start success event 后打开，在 AP stop/fail 后关闭。
241: - AP client join/leave 只更新 client count，不得切换 carrier。
242: - AP active 时扫描首版返回 `-EBUSY`，避免扫描影响 beacon/channel。
243: - `ifdown` 必须停止 active role、关闭 carrier、阻止新 TX，并有界等待旧 TX
244:   ownership 完成；不能只改本地标志。
245: - peer reset 后 active role 变为 unknown，carrier off；重新查询 CP status 后才可
246:   恢复，不能猜测 SoftAP 仍在运行。
247: 
248: ### 4.3 配置隔离
249: 
250: STA 与 SoftAP 使用独立 pending config，至少包括：
251: 
252: ```text
253: STA: ssid, password, auth
254: AP:  ssid, password, security, channel, hidden, max_clients
255: ```
256: 
257: 切换 mode 不能让上一次 STA 密码静默成为 AP 密码，也不能让旧 AP 密码污染下一次
258: 开放热点配置。
259: 
260: ### 4.4 产品运行时序
261: 
262: #### 常规 STA 模式
263: 
264: ```text
265: STA_ONLINE
266:   -> wlan0 连接外部路由器
267:   -> DHCP client 获取地址
268:   -> 维持云端或其他外部网络连接
269: ```
270: 
271: #### 进入配置/文件服务模式
272: 
273: ```text
274: STA_ONLINE
275:   -> ENTER_CONFIG
276:   -> 关闭云端新请求并停止现有网络连接
277:   -> 停止 STA DHCP client
278:   -> STA disconnect/stop
279:   -> 等待 STA disconnected event
280:   -> 清理 STA 地址、路由、TX/RX 状态
281:   -> wlan0 切换到 SoftAP
282:   -> AP start success
283:   -> 设置 AP 静态 IPv4
284:   -> 启动 NuttX DHCP server
285:   -> 启动 HTTP/File Server
286:   -> AP_SERVING
287: ```
288: 
289: #### 退出配置/文件服务模式
290: 
291: ```text
292: AP_SERVING
293:   -> 停止接受新的 HTTP/File 请求
294:   -> 等待或取消在途文件操作
295:   -> 停止 DHCP server
296:   -> SoftAP stop
297:   -> 等待 AP stop event
298:   -> 清理 AP 地址、客户端计数、TX/RX 状态
299:   -> wlan0 切换到 STA
300:   -> 恢复 STA 配置和 STA MAC
301:   -> STA start/connect
302:   -> connected event
303:   -> DHCP renew
304:   -> 恢复云端或其他外部网络连接
305:   -> STA_ONLINE
306: ```
307: 
308: 切换期间不重启单片机，但以下连接状态不保留：
309: 
310: - STA 的 TCP/TLS/MQTT 等外部连接需要关闭并重建。
311: - AP 客户端在退出配置模式时会断开，需要重新关联。
312: - STA 与 AP 的 IPv4 地址、默认路由和 DHCP 状态必须分别清理和重新建立。
313: - HTTP/File Server 进程可以继续运行，但只能在 AP 地址有效且 `AP_SERVING`
314:   状态下对外提供服务。
315: 
316: ### 4.5 运行时切换兼容性要求
317: 
318: 本方案不依赖系统重启，但必须把切换设计成有界状态机：
319: 
320: - 切换前拒绝新的网络业务请求，避免应用继续创建外部 socket。
321: - 停止 active role 后等待对应 CP stop/disconnect event，不以发送 command 成功
322:   作为角色已停止的依据。
323: - 切换前关闭 DHCP client/server，清除旧 IP、网关、DNS 和默认路由。
324: - 阻止新 TX，等待 in-flight TX completion；超时对象进入 quarantine，不能直接
325:   复用共享 buffer。
326: - 清理旧 RX queue，给 RX packet 记录 role，禁止旧 STA frame 被 AP 模式消费，或
327:   反向消费。
328: - 切换 SoftAP/STA 时使用对应角色 MAC，不使用 base MAC 猜测替代。
329: - AP carrier 只有在 AP start success event 后打开，STA carrier 只有在 STA
330:   connected event 后打开。
331: - AP 模式下 HTTP/File Server 只绑定 AP 静态地址；STA 恢复后外部网络服务再绑定
332:   新的 STA 地址或由应用重新建立连接。
333: - 任意 command timeout、CP reset 或 event 丢失都进入 `ERROR`，关闭 carrier 和
334:   DHCP，禁止直接跳到下一角色。
335: 
336: 目标体验是“设备不重启、网络角色可恢复”，不是“网络业务零中断”。实际切换时间
337: 以实板为准，方案目标为 STA 到 AP 可访问约 3 至 8 秒，AP 到 STA 恢复联网约 3
338: 至 15 秒；STA 重新关联和 DHCP 可能使时间进一步增加。
339: 
340: ## 5. Pointer-free SoftAP Wire ABI
341: 
342: ### 5.1 不直接复用 pointer API
343: 
344: CP 的 `cif_wifi_api` 中部分 `AP_SET_CONFIG` API 把参数解释为 CP 可解引用的
345: `wifi_ap_config_t *`。OpenVela 不得跨核传递 NuttX pointer，也不得复制由编译宏、
346: bitfield 和 packing 决定的完整私有结构作为长期 ABI。
347: 
348: 旧 `BK_CMD_START_AP` 虽然是固定 payload，但存在以下问题：
349: 
350: - security 依赖密码长度隐式推导。
351: - 5 GHz 拒绝路径不返回正常 confirmation。
352: - confirmation 在实际 AP start 前发送，无法表示 start 最终结果。
353: - 无 protocol version、配置长度和 SoftAP MAC/status 查询。
354: 
355: 为避免改变原 AVDK AP 的 legacy command 语义，建议增加 OpenVela 专用 command：
356: 
357: ```text
358: 0x210 BK_CMD_OPENVELA_AP_START
359: 0x211 BK_CMD_OPENVELA_AP_STOP
360: 0x212 BK_CMD_OPENVELA_AP_STATUS
361: ```
362: 
363: ### 5.2 建议结构
364: 
365: ```c
366: struct bk7258_wifi_ap_start_request
367: {
368:   uint8_t version;
369:   uint8_t channel;
370:   uint8_t security;
371:   uint8_t hidden;
372:   uint8_t max_clients;
373:   uint8_t ssid_length;
374:   uint8_t password_length;
375:   uint8_t reserved;
376:   uint8_t ssid[32];
377:   uint8_t password[64];
378: };
379: 
380: struct bk7258_wifi_ap_status_response
381: {
382:   int32_t status;
383:   uint8_t started;
384:   uint8_t channel;
385:   uint8_t security;
386:   uint8_t client_count;
387:   uint8_t mac[6];
388:   uint8_t reserved[2];
389: };
390: ```
391: 
392: 实现时必须为 `sizeof`、字段 offset 和 reserved=0 增加两侧 `_Static_assert`。
393: 所有字符串按显式长度解析，CP 落地到 Beken API 前再复制并补 NUL，禁止对 wire
394: 数组直接调用无界 `strlen()`。
395: 
396: ### 5.3 输入校验
397: 
398: AP 和 CP 两侧都必须检查：
399: 
400: - `version` 是双方支持的版本。
401: - SSID 长度为 1 至 32 字节。
402: - Open 模式 password 长度必须为 0。
403: - WPA2-PSK password 长度为 8 至 63 字节。
404: - channel 符合当前 country code。
405: - `hidden` 只能为 0 或 1。
406: - `max_clients` 在 1 至 Beken driver 上限内。
407: - `reserved` 全零。
408: - payload 长度必须精确匹配结构大小。
409: 
410: 普通日志不得打印 SSID 对应的密码或完整 command payload。
411: 
412: ## 6. OpenVela AP 侧修改方案
413: 
414: ### 6.1 `bk7258_wifi_ipc.h`
415: 
416: 新增：
417: 
418: - OpenVela AP command/event 命名常量。
419: - wire VIF 常量：STA=0、SoftAP=1。
420: - 固定宽度 AP request/response。
421: - CPDU `flags` 中 `vif_idx` 的 mask/shift helper，避免 C bitfield ABI。
422: - AP start/stop/assoc/disassoc event payload。
423: - 全部结构的 size/offset assertion。
424: 
425: 禁止引入 `wifi_ap_config_t`、lwIP 类型或 FreeRTOS 类型。
426: 
427: ### 6.2 `bk7258_wifi.c` 控制面
428: 
429: 调整：
430: 
431: - 用 role state mutex 保护 mode/config/start/stop/event。
432: - `wifi_connect()` 按 configured role 分派 STA connect 或 SoftAP start。
433: - `wifi_disconnect()` 按 active role 分派 STA disconnect 或 SoftAP stop。
434: - `wifi_mode()` 校验角色和状态，不再无条件保存任意值。
435: - `wifi_passwd()` 根据 WAPI algorithm 写入角色独立配置。
436: - 实现 `wifi_freq()`，将 channel 作为 AP pending config；active AP 不在线修改。
437: - `wifi_auth()` 只接受首版能够实际执行的 Open/WPA2 参数，未支持值返回
438:   `-EOPNOTSUPP`。
439: - AP config validation 在发送 command 前完成一次，CP 再完成第二次。
440: - 解析 AP start/stop/client events，维护 `ap_started/client_count/carrier`。
441: - 初始化和 peer-reset 恢复时通过 AP status command 取得 SoftAP MAC 与真实状态。
442: 
443: ### 6.3 `bk7258_wifi.c` 数据面
444: 
445: 调整：
446: 
447: - TX slot 保存发送时的 wire role。
448: - STA TX 设置 `vif_idx=0`，SoftAP TX 设置 `vif_idx=1`。
449: - RX 校验并提取 CPDU `vif_idx`。
450: - 首版只接收 active role 对应的 frame；其他 role frame 计数并按原 ownership
451:   协议归还 CP。
452: - RX packet 记录 wire role，防止切换过程中旧 frame 被新角色消费。
453: - role switch 前阻止新 TX，并有界等待旧 TX completion；超时沿用 quarantine，
454:   不猜测性复用共享 buffer。
455: - TX completion 仍按 slot address 回收，不把 Mailbox transport ACK 当成 Wi-Fi
456:   packet completion。
457: 
458: ### 6.4 MAC 与 carrier
459: 
460: - 初始化时分别获取 STA MAC 和 SoftAP MAC。
461: - role 只在 interface 无 carrier、无 in-flight TX 时切换。
462: - 切到 SoftAP 前把 `d_mac` 更新为 Beken `MAC_TYPE_AP` 对应地址。
463: - AP start success 前 carrier 保持 off。
464: - AP stop 后 carrier off，再清 active role。
465: 
466: 若 NuttX upper-half 不允许已注册 netdev 安全更新 MAC，则实施时改为启动时固定选择
467: SoftAP-only 配置；不得静默用 STA/base MAC 冒充 SoftAP MAC。
468: 
469: ## 7. CP 侧修改方案
470: 
471: ### 7.1 控制命令
472: 
473: 在当前 CP `controller_if` 增加 `0x210..0x212` handler：
474: 
475: - 校验固定 payload 和版本。
476: - 映射到本地 `wifi_ap_config_t`。
477: - 依次调用 `bk_wifi_ap_set_config()` 和 `bk_wifi_ap_start()`。
478: - 返回真实 Beken error，不在执行前提前报告成功。
479: - stop 返回 `bk_wifi_ap_stop()` 的真实结果。
480: - status 使用 `bk_wifi_ap_get_config()`、`bk_wifi_ap_get_mac()` 和本地 client
481:   计数生成值语义 response。
482: 
483: legacy `BK_CMD_START_AP/STOP_AP` 保持兼容，不改变原 AVDK AP 行为。
484: 
485: ### 7.2 SoftAP IPv4 所有权开关
486: 
487: 新增一个含义明确的 CP 配置，例如：
488: 
489: ```text
490: CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_OPENVELA_SOFTAP_IPV4=y
491: ```
492: 
493: 该开关只表示“普通 SoftAP 的 IPv4 数据面由 OpenVela 持有”，不能复用含义仅覆盖
494: STA 的 `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_AP_IPV4`。
495: 
496: 开启后：
497: 
498: - `cif_rx_local_packet_check()` 对普通 SoftAP VIF 的 ARP/IPv4 走 direct-push，
499:   并设置 wire VIF 1。
500: - EAPOL 继续留给 CP hostapd。
501: - CP 不对 SoftAP 启动 `uap_ip_start()`、DHCP server、DNS server 或 ARP 响应。
502: - AP stop 只清理 CP 的 Wi-Fi VIF/hostapd 状态，不操作 NuttX DHCP daemon。
503: - STA 的现有 `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_AP_IPV4` 行为保持不变，防止 STA 回归。
504: 
505: 可能涉及的实际构建源：
506: 
507: ```text
508: external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_main.h
509: external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_cntrl.c
510: external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_dp.c
511: bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_v2.c
512: bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/lwip_intf_v2_1/lwip-2.1.2/port/net.c
513: bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config
514: ```
515: 
516: 开工时先用最终 CP compile database/map 确认实际参与构建的源文件。比赛仓中的
517: `external/bk_avdk_smp` 镜像与最终打包使用的 `bk_avdk_smp/cp` 不一致时，先固定
518: 唯一源码所有权和同步方式，禁止只改参考副本。
519: 
520: ### 7.3 CP 数据面门禁
521: 
522: CP 侧必须新增统计或临时 trace 证明：
523: 
524: - SoftAP EAPOL 留在 CP。
525: - SoftAP ARP、DHCP、普通 IPv4 发送到 wire VIF 1。
526: - CP DHCP server 未启动。
527: - NuttX TX wire VIF 1 能映射到当前真实 SoftAP LMAC VIF。
528: - STA wire VIF 0 仍保持原行为。
529: 
530: ## 8. NuttX 配置与使用流程
531: 
532: ### 8.1 defconfig 增量
533: 
534: `nsh` 和需要 SoftAP 的 `ai_agent` 配置至少增加：
535: 
536: ```text
537: CONFIG_NET_BROADCAST=y
538: CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD=y
539: CONFIG_EXAMPLES_DHCPD=y
540: CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_STARTIP=0xc0a80a02
541: CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_ROUTERIP=0xc0a80a01
542: CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_NETMASK=0xffffff00
543: CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_DNSIP=0x00000000
544: CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD_MAXLEASES=4
545: ```
546: 
547: 首版使用 `192.168.10.1/24`，地址池从 `192.168.10.2` 开始。DNS 设置为 0，
548: 因为首版没有 NAT、DNS proxy 或上游转发能力，不能向客户端虚假通告公网 DNS。
549: 
550: ### 8.2 预期 NSH 操作
551: 
552: WPA2-PSK：
553: 
554: ```sh
555: wapi disconnect wlan0
556: ifup wlan0
557: wapi mode wlan0 3
558: wapi freq wlan0 6 1
559: wapi psk wlan0 <8至63字节密码> 3
560: wapi essid wlan0 <SSID> 1

172: 	bool "Keep PSRAM powered while AP runs"

178: 
179: 
180: config BK7258_AUDIO
181: 	bool "BK7258 internal analog audio (AUD)"
182: 	default n
183: 	select AUDIO
184: 	help
185: 		Drive the chip's internal 16-bit mono DAC and analog MIC ADC. On this
186: 		board the differential AUDLP/AUDLN pair feeds an HT6872 class-D
187: 		amplifier whose CTRL (mute) pin is GPIO50, and there is no I2S codec.
188: 		Asks CP1 for the AUDP power domain and the AUD module clock over the
189: 		PWC mailbox channel.
190: 
191: config BK7258_AUDIO_CAPTURE
192: 	bool "BK7258 audio capture (MIC1 + AEC reference)"
193: 	default n
194: 	depends on BK7258_AUDIO
195: 	help
196: 		Enable the ADC path. MIC1 (MICP1/MICN1) is the electret microphone.
197: 		When BK7258_AUDIO_AEC_REFERENCE is also set, MIC2 (MICP2/MICN2) is
198: 		enabled as well and carries the post-amplifier speaker feedback, so
199: 		captured frames are L/R interleaved with L = voice and R = echo
200: 		reference.
201: 
202: config BK7258_AUDIO_AEC_REFERENCE
203: 	bool "Capture the MIC2 hardware echo reference"
204: 	default n
205: 	depends on BK7258_AUDIO_CAPTURE
206: 	help
207: 		The schematic taps HT6872 OUT+/OUT- through R84/R83 (39K) and
208: 		C61/C60 (1uF) into MIC2P/MIC2N so that AEC can have a hardware echo
209: 		reference, and ana_reg27 does have a full micen field for MIC2.
210: 
211: 		This defaults to n because the reference cannot actually be read on
212: 		BK7258: measured on hardware, the ADC delivers a single channel and
213: 		the upper half of every AUD_ADC_FIFO_PORT word stays zero. With a
214: 		tone audibly playing and MIC1 picking it up acoustically (RMS rising
215: 		from 25.7 to 36.4), MIC2 still returned exactly zero across 15872
216: 		samples. That matches the vendor HAL, where sys_hal_aud_mic2_en()
217: 		and sys_hal_aud_dacr_en() are both explicit "//not support" stubs
218: 		for this SoC: the register fields exist, the datapath does not.
219: 
220: 		Enabling this only costs half of every capture buffer to zeros. Use
221: 		a software AEC reference instead -- feed aec_proc() the same PCM
222: 		that was queued to the DAC, which is cleaner anyway (no analog
223: 		noise, no divider tolerance) and needs only a fixed delay
224: 		compensation for the DAC and amplifier.
225: 
226: config BK7258_AUDIO_SAMPLERATE
227: 	int "Default audio sample rate"
228: 	default 16000
229: 	depends on BK7258_AUDIO
230: 	help
231: 		Used when the application does not configure a rate explicitly. Only
232: 		8000, 16000 and 32000 are currently reachable: the driver runs the
233: 		audio block from the 26 MHz crystal, and the 44100/48000 families
234: 		additionally require the APLL calibration sequence, which has not
235: 		been ported yet.
236: 
237: config BK7258_AUDIO_PA_MUTE_GPIO
238: 	int "External amplifier mute GPIO"
239: 	default 50
240: 	depends on BK7258_AUDIO
241: 	help
242: 		BK7258 GPIO driving net MUTE, which reaches the HT6872 CTRL pin
243: 		through R70 (1K). R71 (10K) pulls it low, so the amplifier is muted
244: 		until software drives this pin high. Per the board schematic
245: 		(AIDK_AI玩具开发板_原理图.pdf) MUTE is P50.
246: 
247: config BK7258_AUDIO_PA_ON_DELAY_MS
248: 	int "Delay between DAC enable and amplifier un-mute"
249: 	default 20
250: 	depends on BK7258_AUDIO
251: 	help
252: 		Mirrors onboard_speaker_stream's pa_on_delay: the DAC is started,
253: 		this delay elapses, then the amplifier is un-muted. Keeps the
254: 		amplifier off while the analog output settles so there is no pop.
255: 
256: config BK7258_AUDIO_PA_OFF_DELAY_MS
257: 	int "Delay between DAC mute and amplifier shutdown"
258: 	default 10
259: 	depends on BK7258_AUDIO
260: 	help
261: 		Mirrors onboard_speaker_stream's pa_off_delay. Note the vendor's
262: 		header comment and its code disagree on where this delay sits; the
263: 		code order (mute, delay, amplifier off, DAC teardown) is the one that
264: 		actually suppresses the pop and is what this driver implements.
265:

272: 	select SCHED_HPWORK
273: 	help

277: 		This is a software encoder built on libjpeg-turbo. The chip's hardware
278: 		JPEG block is fed by the DVP camera interface and cannot read pixels
279: 		from memory, so it cannot back a memory-to-memory codec; that block
280: 		belongs to the capture driver instead.

282: 		Buffers are allocated from PSRAM, since one 640x480 frame exceeds the
283: 		AP's entire malloc heap.

1511:       return ret;

1516:   tx->transport_pending = true;

1519:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu,
1520:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu, 1,
1521:                        wifi_tx_transport_complete, tx);
1522:   if (ret < 0)
1523:     {
1524:       tx->packet = NULL;
1525:       tx->active = false;
1526:       tx->transport_pending = false;
1527:     }
1528:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1529:   return ret;

1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
2: # Flash a BK7258 board by asking the running firmware to reboot into bootrom.
3: # Keep operational logs visible in the invoking shell; file logs are secondary.
4: 
5: set -u
6: 
7: SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)
8: 
9: find_root() {
10:   local dir=$SCRIPT_DIR
11: 
12:   while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do
13:     if [ -x "$dir/bk_loader" ] || [ -x "$dir/tools/bk_loader" ]; then
14:       printf '%s\n' "$dir"
15:       return 0
16:     fi
17:     dir=$(dirname -- "$dir")
18:   done
19:   return 1
20: }
21: 
22: ROOT=${VELA_ROOT:-$(find_root)}
23: LOADER=${BK_LOADER:-}
24: if [ -z "$LOADER" ]; then
25:   if [ -x "$ROOT/bk_loader" ]; then
26:     LOADER="$ROOT/bk_loader"
27:   else
28:     LOADER="$ROOT/tools/bk_loader"
29:   fi
30: fi
31: 
32: DEFAULT_IMAGE="$ROOT/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin"
33: RUNTIME_DIR=${AUTOFLASH_RUNTIME_DIR:-"$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/runtime"}
34: EXPECTED_SIZE=${AUTOFLASH_EXPECTED_SIZE:-2646016}
35: 
36: PORT=/dev/ttyUSB0
37: PORTNUM=""
38: PORTNUM_SET=0
39: BAUD=115200
40: CONSOLE_BAUD=115200
41: IMAGE="$DEFAULT_IMAGE"
42: REBOOT_TRIES=8
43: ATTACH_SERIAL=0
44: SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=0
45: TEST_ONLY=0
46: 
47: LOG=""
48: FIFO=""
49: LOADER_PID=""
50: TEE_PID=""
51: 
52: usage() {
53:   cat <<'EOF'
54: 用法: autoflash.sh [选项]
55: 
56:   -i <file>    要烧录的镜像，默认使用工程构建出的 all-app.bin
57:   -p <port>    串口设备，默认 /dev/ttyUSB0
58:   -n <num>     bk_loader 端口号；默认从 ttyUSB<num> 自动推导
59:   -b <baud>    烧录波特率，默认 115200
60:   -B <baud>    固件控制台波特率，默认 115200
61:   -s           跳过 all-app.bin 字节数校验
62:   -a           烧录成功后用 picocom 连接串口
63:   -t           只测试握手，不写 flash
64:   -h           显示帮助
65: 
66: 环境变量: VELA_ROOT、BK_LOADER、AUTOFLASH_RUNTIME_DIR、
67:           AUTOFLASH_EXPECTED_SIZE 可覆盖自动检测的默认值。
68: 
69: 日志约束: 烧录过程优先在当前 Shell 实时显示，同时保存文件用于追溯；
70:           不使用仅写文件、完成后再读取的日志方式。
71: EOF
72: }
73: 
74: die() {
75:   echo "错误: $*" >&2
76:   exit 1
77: }
78: 
79: cleanup() {
80:   local rc=$?
81: 
82:   trap - EXIT INT TERM HUP
83:   if [ -n "$LOADER_PID" ] && kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
84:     kill "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
85:     wait "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
86:   fi
87:   if [ -n "$TEE_PID" ] && kill -0 "$TEE_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
88:     kill "$TEE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
89:     wait "$TEE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
90:   fi
91:   [ -z "$FIFO" ] || rm -f -- "$FIFO"
92:   exit "$rc"
93: }
94: 
95: trap cleanup EXIT
96: trap 'exit 130' INT
97: trap 'exit 143' TERM
98: trap 'exit 129' HUP
99: 
100: while getopts "i:p:n:b:B:sath" opt; do
101:   case "$opt" in
102:     i) IMAGE=$OPTARG ;;
103:     p) PORT=$OPTARG ;;
104:     n) PORTNUM=$OPTARG; PORTNUM_SET=1 ;;
105:     b) BAUD=$OPTARG ;;
106:     B) CONSOLE_BAUD=$OPTARG ;;
107:     s) SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=1 ;;
108:     a) ATTACH_SERIAL=1 ;;
109:     t) TEST_ONLY=1 ;;
110:     h) trap - EXIT INT TERM HUP; usage; exit 0 ;;
111:     *) usage; exit 2 ;;
112:   esac
113: done
114: 
115: case "$BAUD" in *[!0-9]*|'') die "烧录波特率必须是正整数: $BAUD" ;; esac
116: case "$CONSOLE_BAUD" in *[!0-9]*|'') die "控制台波特率必须是正整数: $CONSOLE_BAUD" ;; esac
117: [ "$BAUD" -gt 0 ] || die "烧录波特率必须大于 0"
118: [ "$CONSOLE_BAUD" -gt 0 ] || die "控制台波特率必须大于 0"
119: 
120: if [ "$PORTNUM_SET" -eq 0 ]; then
121:   case "$PORT" in
122:     /dev/ttyUSB[0-9]*) PORTNUM=${PORT#/dev/ttyUSB} ;;
123:     *) die "无法从 $PORT 推导 bk_loader 端口号，请使用 -n 指定" ;;
124:   esac
125: fi
126: case "$PORTNUM" in *[!0-9]*|'') die "bk_loader 端口号必须是非负整数: $PORTNUM" ;; esac
127: 
128: for command_name in fuser grep mkfifo sha256sum stat stdbuf stty tee timeout tr; do
129:   command -v "$command_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "缺少命令: $command_name"
130: done
131: 
132: [ -x "$LOADER" ] || die "找不到 bk_loader: $LOADER"
133: [ -c "$PORT" ] || die "串口不存在: $PORT（板子插了吗？）"
134: [ -r "$PORT" ] && [ -w "$PORT" ] || die "无权读写串口: $PORT（检查 dialout 组权限）"
135: mkdir -p -- "$RUNTIME_DIR" || die "无法创建运行记录目录: $RUNTIME_DIR"
136: 
137: if [ "$TEST_ONLY" -eq 0 ]; then
138:   [ -f "$IMAGE" ] && [ -r "$IMAGE" ] || die "找不到或无法读取镜像: $IMAGE"
139:   SIZE=$(stat -c%s -- "$IMAGE") || die "无法读取镜像大小"
140:   SHA=$(sha256sum -- "$IMAGE" | cut -d' ' -f1) || die "无法计算镜像 SHA256"
141:   XFER_SECS=$(( (SIZE * 10 + BAUD - 1) / BAUD ))
142:   OVERALL_TIMEOUT=$(( XFER_SECS * 2 + 60 ))
143: 
144:   echo "=== 待烧录镜像 ==="
145:   echo "  路径   : $IMAGE"
146:   echo "  字节数 : $SIZE"
147:   echo "  SHA256 : $SHA"
148:   echo "  串口   : $PORT（bk_loader 端口 $PORTNUM）"
149:   echo "  烧录   : ${BAUD} baud，传输约 ${XFER_SECS}s，超时 ${OVERALL_TIMEOUT}s"
150:   echo "  控制台 : ${CONSOLE_BAUD} baud"
151: 
152:   if [ "$SKIP_SIZE_CHECK" -eq 0 ] && [ "$(basename -- "$IMAGE")" = "all-app.bin" ]; then
153:     [ "$SIZE" -eq "$EXPECTED_SIZE" ] \
154:       || die "all-app.bin 应为 $EXPECTED_SIZE 字节，实际 $SIZE；用 -s 可跳过检查"
155:     echo "  字节数校验通过"
156:   fi
157: else
158:   OVERALL_TIMEOUT=40
159:   echo "=== 只测试握手，不写 flash ==="
160:   echo "  串口   : $PORT（bk_loader 端口 $PORTNUM）"
161:   echo "  烧录   : ${BAUD} baud"
162:   echo "  控制台 : ${CONSOLE_BAUD} baud"
163: fi
164: 
165: echo
166: echo "=== 检查串口 ==="
167: HOLDERS=$(fuser "$PORT" 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ')
168: if [ -n "$HOLDERS" ]; then
169:   echo "  当前占用: $HOLDERS"
170:   for holder in $HOLDERS; do
171:     PROCESS_NAME=""
172:     IFS= read -r PROCESS_NAME < "/proc/$holder/comm" 2>/dev/null || true
173:     case "$PROCESS_NAME" in
174:       cat|picocom|minicom|screen|SCREEN)
175:         echo "  关闭 $PROCESS_NAME（PID $holder）"
176:         kill "$holder" 2>/dev/null || true
177:         ;;
178:     esac
179:   done
180:   sleep 0.5

- AP builds a CPDU plus 12-byte command header, assigns a sequence, and waits up to two seconds for `command + 0x8000` with the same sequence: [bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:269).
- The mailbox transport ACK only clears `transport_pending`; it is not the command result: [bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:235).
- CP mailbox RX queues command/data work into the CIF thread: [cif_main.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_main.c:122). The CIF thread dispatches commands at lines 83-92.
- IDs `0x300..0x5fe` go to the generic Wi-Fi API dispatcher; other IDs go to the legacy switch: [cif_cntrl.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_cntrl.c:1046).
- Confirmations use ID `cmd_id + 0x8000` and echo `cmd_sn`; events use their bare event ID: [cif_cntrl.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_cntrl.c:116), [cif_cntrl.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_cntrl.c:159).
- OpenVela currently handles only IPv4/STA connection, disconnect, scan-done, and generic Wi-Fi events. It does not process AP start/stop/client events: [bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:770).

**Data Path**

- CP wire roles are 0=infra STA, 1=SoftAP, 2=P2P GO, 3=P2P GC and are mapped dynamically to real LMAC VIFs: [cif_wifi_dp.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_dp.c:46).
- AP-to-CP TX reverses that role mapping and adds the downstream `+0xf` tag: [cif_wifi_dp.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_dp.c:138).
- If no matching role exists, the reverse lookup falls back to the wire number. Sending wire 1 while SoftAP is stopped can therefore target an unintended LMAC index; role state must prevent TX in starting/stopped/error states.
- RX records `vif_idx` in two bits and `dst_index` in four bits: [cif_main.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_main.h:262).
- Current OpenVela TX zeroes CPDU flags, fixing all output to wire 0: [bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1497).
- Current OpenVela RX validates ownership but ignores both `vif_idx` and `dst_index`, placing every accepted frame in one queue: [bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:995).
- Current CP offload condition applies only to non-P2P STA: [cif_wifi_dp.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_dp.c:438). EAPOL remains CP-owned; STA ARP/IPv4 are forwarded to OpenVela.
- CP SoftAP still calls `uap_ip_start()`, configures `g_uap`, and starts its DHCP server: [wifi_v2.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_wifi/src/wifi_v2.c:3447), [net.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/lwip_intf_v2_1/lwip-2.1.2/port/net.c:801), [net.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/lwip_intf_v2_1/lwip-2.1.2/port/net.c:1120).

**Primary Risks**

- A command confirmation, mailbox transport ACK, and AP operational event are three different completion points. Treating any earlier point as “AP up” creates false carrier and premature DHCP startup.
- CP and OpenVela currently duplicate CPDU, pbuf, message, scan, country, and proposed AP structs. Existing assertions cover mostly total size, not every field offset or bit encoding: [bk7258_wifi_ipc.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/hardware/bk7258_wifi_ipc.h:137). Add size and `offsetof` assertions on both sides and use masks instead of cross-compiler C bitfields.
- Shared direct-push depends on an exact 32-bit lwIP `pbuf + CPDU` ABI and refcount behavior. A toolchain, packing, cacheability, or pbuf layout change can become memory corruption.
- Merely forwarding SoftAP frames without disabling CP `uap_ip_start()` produces dual DHCP/ARP ownership.
- No repository runtime log demonstrates SoftAP startup or DHCP. The SoftAP plan explicitly remains unimplemented: [BK7258_OPENVELA_WIFI_AP_MODE_PORTING_PLAN.md](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/docs/plans/BK7258_OPENVELA_WIFI_AP_MODE_PORTING_PLAN.md:1).
